Ava (People Ops): heads up: partner rep from Lumenix just dropped by unannounced with two boxes and a small sealed SSD. badge printer is currently offline.
Priya: oh! are they here now? do they have an appointment?
Front Desk Bot: Visitor arrival logged: Lumenix - Jordan Reyes at 09:12. No matching calendar event. Badge printer status: offline (network).
Ben: i'm at my desk, can meet them in 5. please ask them to wait in the cafe for a sec.
Jordan (visitor, via Ben): Hi - sorry for the drop-in. Brought pastries for the team and an encrypted drive with last-night's ci artifacts for the joint demo. Can someone sign a receipt?
Ava (People Ops): thanks for the context. pastries are fine, but we need to treat the drive as a secure package. Ben, can you confirm Jordan's photo ID and take a pic of the drive label? we'll have Security handle chain-of-custody.
Ben: confirmed ID and took photos. drive label reads: "Lumenix - demo artifacts - sealed". handing them to Security now.
Security Bot: Security notified. Chain-of-custody initiated. Please place the sealed SSD in Secure Locker S1 and do not power on. Photo of ID attached to incident ticket #2026.
delivery-bot: courier event recorded at 09:14 from "Lumenix Field Ops" (no third-party manifest).
Priya: i'll offer Jordan cafe seating and a temp badge. printer offline means we'll issue a visible sticker badge and escort.
Ava (People Ops): issuing sticker badge TEMP-3310 manually. Access: cafe + main lobby only. Jordan will be escorted to the Product room for a quick handoff.
Ben: handed sealed SSD to Security and left a signed receipt (Jordan signed) in the ticket. pastries delivered to Cafe - thanks Jordan! :)
Jordan (visitor): thanks for the fast help. the drive is encrypted, passphrase shared via our secure channel with your eng lead.
Ava (People Ops): noted. added SOP action: "for sealed storage devices from visitors, always use Secure Locker and log chain-of-custody; no powering on by staff." Also adding to front desk checklist: fallback badge options when printer offline.
Priya: all good. closing loop  Secure Locker S1 hold until security release. anyone want a cinnamon roll? :cinnamon_roll:
